summary: Tested Social Media Sharing feature for external agencies. Fixed critical SelectItem value bug in Create Link dialog. All 16 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend UI fully functional.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED - SelectItem with value='' caused runtime error when opening Create Link dialog

backend_apis.GET /api/social-sharing/collaborators: WORKING - Returns collaborators and pending_invitations list
backend_apis.POST /api/social-sharing/collaborators/i: WORKING - Creates invitation for new user or adds existing user
backend_apis.GET /api/social-sharing/links: WORKING - Returns list of active share links
backend_apis.POST /api/social-sharing/links: WORKING - Creates share link with URL, supports password and expiry
backend_apis.POST /api/social-sharing/access/validate: WORKING - Public endpoint, validates external access token

frontend_ui.SocialSharing_component: WORKING - Renders in Social Media > Settings tab under 'Share with Agencies' section
frontend_ui.Internal_Collaborators_card: WORKING - Shows pending invitations, Invite button opens dialog with email/permission fields
frontend_ui.External_Links_card: WORKING - Shows share links with URL, views, expiry, copy/delete buttons, Create Link button works
frontend_ui.Invite_dialog: WORKING - Email input, permissions dropdown (Viewer/Contributor), Send Invitation button
frontend_ui.Create_Link_dialog: WORKING - Name, password (optional), expiry dropdown, permissions dropdown, Create Link button

seed_data_creation: Test share links and invitations created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Social sharing feature is fully implemented. Backend supports internal collaborators (Kora users) and external links (public URLs with optional password). Fixed SelectItem empty value bug in frontend. Navigate to: Demand Generation > Social Media > Settings > Scroll to 'Share with Agencies' section.

bugs_fixed.issue: SelectItem with value='' in expiry dropdown caused React error: 'A <Select.Item /> must have a value prop that is not an empty string'
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed value='' to value='never' and updated handleCreateLink to handle 'never' value correctly (sends null for expires_in_days)
